stem:
Meera watches the hands of the wall clock in her classroom and also sees her brother Arjun riding the giant wheel at the village fair.
Which of these motions is an example of circular motion?

options.text: A ball rolling straight down the corridor of Meera's house
The tip of the minute hand of the wall clock as it moves
Arjun cycling in a straight line along the road to school
A swing moving to and fro after one push

teacher.key_rationale: Circular motion occurs when an object moves along a circular path. The tip of the minute hand of a clock traces a circle around the centre of the clock face, so B is circular motion. A ball rolling straight and cycling along a straight road are rectilinear motion, and a swing moving to and fro is periodic (oscillatory) motion, not circular.
